# Week 9: Execution logs and event templates — Student edition

## Goal
Turn messages into event templates using a conventional parser and an LLM, then examine grouping errors and downstream event counts.

## How to work through this notebook

Keep your traditional analysis independent of the model's suggestions, then compare on matched inputs. Record uncertainties rather than inventing results.

This edition contains no worked outputs or model-answer fixtures. Development/training outcomes needed for supervised learning are input data; evaluation answers are withheld. 2. When is a number an event-defining constant rather than a variable?
3. How can template merging hide an unusual event?
4. What changes when the evaluation contains previously unseen templates?
